best_idea: An NPC that loses sight keeps walking to the last reachable point it tracked, a sound near the enemy refreshes that point, and the player's homing shot falls back to the healthiest enemy already hunting it.
decision_why: Take the split between visible (trace) and in-FOV (cone flag), the per-frame tracked point, and the lock fallback to the most-health hunter for chase, leash and the server shot-target rule; reject the per-monster script ordering because Frankendom has one engine and the decision lives there.
acceptance: A server test asserts that an NPC which loses sight keeps its chase point at the last reachable point it tracked, moves that point again on a sound within 2048 units, and that a player's lock shot with no enemy on the aim line picks the hunter with the most health.
